The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1c4d90b5ed4de2ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. statement: Let G be any torsion-free discrete group. (i) For every q ≥ 1 and every idempotent e ∈ Mq(CG), τG,q(e) = rankC ϵG,q(e)  . Consequently τG,∗ = rkϵ, with Z viewed as a subgroup of C, and τG,∗ K0(CG)  = Z. (ii) For every commutative unital domain R of characteristic zero, every e ∈ RG satisfying e2 = e is either 0 or 1.
